title: AARO appointed to head a space tiger team on UAP in space

tellings.quote:
Arrow was um appointed to head some sort
of a space tiger restudy team to examine
UAPs in space of some kind or another.

plain: AARO, the Pentagon office set up to look into unexplained objects in the sky, was put in charge of a small special team to study such objects in space, according to a researcher who is a guest on the show. The guest only mentions this briefly and does not give a source or any details. It suggests the government is taking these sightings beyond Earth's air seriously.
